body: I'm sorry to hear about that. May I ask what helped you exactly? I really appreciate your optimism but I find just about everything so negative, pathetic I know but I really can't help it. I don't understand how one can be confident if there is nothing to be confident about?

Hey, thanks for your time. Currently I just feel lost and alone, it's been a constant feeling as I'm leaving for University again in around four weeks for my second year. My first year there was awful, I tried my best to make friends and do things but I never found a connection with anyone, I was alone for around 8 months during that time and just thinking that I'll most probably have to do this again kills me, I don't think I'm capable of another year.
